title: centaurea scabiosa var. coriacea
intro: Centaurea scabiosa var. coriacea, commonly known as scabiosa, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which provide therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of scabiosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its health benefits, such as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health.
